published_prior_art.cite: Artstein1983 gives general selection-capacity inequalities; LaiRobbins1976 gives the identical-marginal extremal maximum construction, but neither verified source states this heterogeneous finite-pmf iff.

Shahn2026Oracle Appendix A couples incompatible branch objects for endpoint sharpness; GreseleEtAl2022 studies global categorical SCM compatibility, neither states this complete dormant-fiber FFRCISTG projection question.

Shahn2026Oracle proves sharp binary endpoints and two attained CDF-envelope distributions, not equality between the full discrete oracle-law polytope and a complete dormant-branch FFRCISTG completion class.
Russell2021 supplies generic random-set/transport LP machinery, but not the asserted reach-rescaled laminar SMART formulation of tree-linear size.

Shahn2026Oracle Section 4 establishes attained lower and upper oracle CDF envelopes; it does not exhibit a positive open SMART-law class with an interior-envelope pmf excluded by a cross-threshold facet.
HuangEtAl2017 treats static ordinal sharp-bound inference and OberReynolds2023 treats scalar optimal-transport endpoint inference, not finite-sample containment of a longitudinal full-law polytope.
Shahn2026Oracle Theorem 1 gives the sharp binary oracle interval under consistency, sequential exchangeability, positivity, and FFRCISTG.

soundness_flags.label: ass:swig-modularity
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited SWIG modularity result links factual and single-world factorization kernels, but the stated requirement of supplied, exactly shared kernel versions on every dormant zero-probability fiber is an additional version-completion condition, not the standard FFRCISTG/SWIG assumption under that name.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:compact-formulation; thm:strict-nonrectangularity; thm:whole-set-confidence
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exact causal sharpness, the attaining sampler, and confidence containment depend on a favorable resolution of thm:tree-projection-lift; the numerical response-type checks do not establish that lift.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The compact formulation, identified-set nonrectangularity, and whole-set coverage are conditional corollaries under the projection-and-lift equality.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Theorem 1 and Appendix A; Section 4, especially lines 90-110 and Appendix A lines 177-194 in the rendered primary preprint
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 gives sharp binary oracle bounds under consistency, sequential exchangeability, positivity, and FFRCISTG; Section 4 constructs lower and upper CDF envelopes and says the envelope functions are jointly attainable, while Appendix A couples incompatible action subtrees for endpoint constructions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 16, discussion of factorization and modularity
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines modularity as a link between distributions factoring on the factual graph and the relevant SWIG, and describes the conditional distribution for a counterfactual variable as obtained from its factual counterpart; it does not state the proposal's supplied, shared zero-probability-fiber kernel-version requirement.
The paper formalizes categorical SCM compatibility using response functions and studies joint SCMs counterfactually consistent with overlapping marginal SCMs.
For arbitrary common marginal F, the paper constructs maximally dependent variables with maximum survival probability min{1,n[1-F(x)]}.
The publication characterizes distributions of random-set selections through inequalities and records convexity, compactness, and continuity of the resulting distribution class.
The article gives a random-set/convex-optimization method for sharply bounding continuous functionals of the joint potential-outcome distribution and discusses linear-program implementation.

The paper characterizes scalar sharp identified-set endpoints by optimal-transport values and proposes dual sample analogues that are root-n consistent and asymptotically distributed under mild assumptions.
The article studies sharp ordinal-treatment-benefit bounds in randomized trials, establishes plug-in inconsistency under support restrictions, and gives a consistent LP-based estimator.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag ass:swig-modularity as novel and give a precise justification, or replace it with a theorem-level kernel-extension lemma proving that compatible dormant-fiber versions can be selected from ordinary FFRCISTG/SWIG primitives.
State positivity explicitly in the projection-and-lift and lift-question hypotheses, since reach rescaling and terminal branch functionals divide by products of assignment probabilities.
Add a focused comparison to FanPark2010 and Ponomarev2024, explaining why static distributional/inequality-selection results do not furnish the dynamic full-law lift or the tree-size formulation.

recommended_next_step: Revise the nonstandard dormant-fiber modularity assumption and explicitly bind positivity to the lift target, then advance the retained field-tier projection-and-lift angle.
